headline: Weathered Expanse Flare-Up Intensifies as Frontline Clashes Churn
war_summary: Intense fighting has flared sharply across Weathered Expanse over the past two hours, with half a dozen fresh engagements around Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest, and Frostmarch accelerating casualty tallies on both sides. In Palantine Berm and the Gutter, active base exchanges continue around Windburn Landing, Kuoppa, and Rikki Sarana, though raw casualty rates in the Gutter have cooled somewhat from their initial surge. Linn of Mercy has witnessed an abrupt resurgence in combat intensity over the last hour, driving heavy Warden losses near Outwich Ranch even as base ownership holds static for now. To the west, the vicious meatgrinder along the Nevish Line has eased slightly in pace following earlier clashes at Blackcoat Way, while Callahan's Passage and Stonecradle continue to absorb heavy attrition without strategic shifts. Meanwhile, Marban Hollow and Stlican Shelf have quieted after earlier territory turnover, leaving central and northern salients at the center of the conflict.
